description:
FILED s530c (Opus agent, 2026-10-31) as the residue of #4042.  PRE-EXISTING (base 0fb05a79) and NOT fixed by #4042, which merges the `use re '/FLAGS'` defaults into every pattern the FILE compiles.

    { use re '/i'; print "s ", (eval q{"Q" =~ /q/} ? "ok" : "no"), "\n"; }
  perl 5.40.3: s ok        PCL (s530c tree): s no
Probe scratch/s530c/pr/re1.pl row s.

perl compiles a string eval with the hints of the eval SITE (%^H included), so the pragma's default modifiers reach the eval text's patterns.  PCL hands the eval text's transpile the site's FEATURES (#364: `_eval_site_features` -> pl2cl's `<features>` wire line -> Parser2 `eval_features`) but not the `re` hints.  Fix shape: the eval site's `re_pragma_at` state (Pl::Parser2) joins the site facts (a pseudo-feature token such as `re-flags:i`), and `re_pragma_at` on an eval document starts from it instead of from nothing; it is then part of the eval cache key like the features already are.  `use re 'eval'` would ride the same token.
subject: a STRING eval compiled inside `use re '/FLAGS'` does not inherit the default modifiers (`{ use re "/i"; eval q{"Q" =~ /q/} }` is false) -- the eval site hands the transpile its features, not its re hints
